title: Broken link to Bedrock/Vertex docs
body:
On https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/overview the link to `Amazon Bedrock and Google Vertex AI` redirects to https://docs.anthropic.com/en/home. It should instead directly link to useful documentation on bedrock/vertex.
